brief.goal: Add authenticated LAN access, single-owner advertiser isolation and per-user workflow reporting without changing the seven-node workflow or Plan-bound execution semantics.
database_write_scope: Task, Manifest, project state, docs, migrations, authentication/session code, ownership enforcement, reporting views, frontend and focused tests

allowed_writes: authentication/session/user administration, single-owner account binding, actor audit fields, user-scoped reads, reporting views, LAN origin configuration, focused tests and mechanism documentation
forbidden_actions: all real platform writes, confirmations, monitor/resource/project creates, retries, token refreshes, budget or bid changes
new workflow node, business Gate, Plan/action type or confirmation phrase
automatic advertiser ownership transfer or rewriting historical runtime facts
raw credential, transcript, request, response, payload or sensitive URL persistence
validation_plan: authentication, forced password change, session revocation and admin read-only behavior
Intake owner match/mismatch, existing-account isolation and URL/API tampering
user detail/admin summary report cardinality and verified-only success semantics
schema, API, workflow, Case, runtime policy, conversation and diff checks
stop_conditions: any real platform write would be required
the change would weaken exact Plan confirmation, single-attempt execution or authoritative readback
account ownership cannot be established by an exact active user owner key

result.tests: authentication, password change, cross-user HTTP, reports, Intake ownership, runtime policy, conversation, Case, execution grant, API, schema and runtime consistency passed
result.deployment: local service and deployment package ready; waiting for final internal HTTPS hostname and trusted certificate paths
